item.title: Light you can move
item.description: Out of the workshop # Molecule is where I bring my interests in software, light, and physical interaction together. The pop-up at Moongoat Coffee was a chance to take that work into a shared space.

item.title: Part of the scene
item.description: Software in a physical scene # At Paper Ghost, I developed interactive media for film and television: software, screen visuals, and animation that had to work within a real production.

item.title: Movement as an interface
item.description: A moving person as the input # At Enflux, I built software that connected motion capture clothing to interactive applications and creative workflows. The work ranged from a Unity SDK for developers to first-party applications and live demonstrations.

item.title: Behind the creative world
item.description: Engineering that supports creative work # My work on Hearthstone at Blizzard covered the core technology that helps a creative game run, grow, and reach players across platforms. It brought together engine behavior, content delivery, performance constraints, and the tools used by other disciplines.
